newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola estimates shaved.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola estimates shaved.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said Tuesday it is trimming its 1997 earnings estimate for Motorola Inc to $2.80 a share from $3.00 based on more conservative margin and revenue assumptions in both the cellular and semiconductor operations.
The estimate remains above the $2.66 consensus of Wall Street analysts, said Gruntal analyst Mona Eraiba.
She also said she is maintaining her 1998 earnings estimate at $4.00 and projecting 1999 earnings at $5.50.

"We believe that Motorola is poised for a strong phase of earnings growth that should exceed 25 percent, driven by strong demand for cellular products and a new cycle for semiconductors," she said in a report.
Eraiba repeated her strong buy recommendation.
Shares of Motorola were trading up 1-1/4 to 84-5/8.
